comment: Suppressive fire tuning (game designer decisions 2026-10-26; spec docs/design/SUPPRESSION.md). Read by SuppressionRules::GetConfig (Source/CodexTactics/Public/Combat/SuppressionRules.h) at game start; the FSuppressionConfig defaults mirror these values (test CodexTactics.Combat.Suppression.TuningFileMirrorsDefaults). Levels are 0..1, distances cm, times s. Per-weapon full-auto cadence and suppression weight: Content/Data/Weapons/weapons_tuning.json (full_auto_interval, suppression_weight). A/B: console variable Codex.Combat.Suppression 0 = no suppression.
